summary: A prompt card on a member other than the seat's host reads and follows the seat's conversation through the client-read relay, so it can offer allow there

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: presentation.prompt on a harness-prompt card for a seat another member runs now carries its named call and allow, read through the client-read relay as the seat's person, instead of calls null with unknown_reason. A member that reaches no peer for that host still says why. The host must answer relayed Timeline and ConversationChanges reads, as it already does for clients.

downtime.detail: No startup work. For each prompt card whose seat another member runs, the attention refresher holds one relayed changes wait (at most 10 s per read) on that host and reads the seat's newest page when it changes.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; an older daemon shows such a card as unknown again.
